name: Reference Lock Policy
purpose: Prevent a resolved current-task user reference from being silently replaced by a Product Master, Design System, existing target, memory, or inferred content pattern.

rules: When an exact current-task user visual reference is present and the request asks to match/follow/use it, that reference becomes primary visual authority.
An exact current-task user Figma node explicitly identified as the reference is primary visual authority unless the user explicitly says it is only supporting material.
A Product Master may support domain behavior/content/system context but must not replace a locked user visual authority.

The Core/Domain Design System owns component identity, tokens, typography foundations, and primitive behavior; it does not override locked composition/layout unless the user explicitly authorizes that change.
Existing target content, labels, or product semantics must never be used to infer a different visual authority when a user reference is locked.
If the user refers to a prior reference and it cannot be retrieved with evidence, return BLOCKED_REFERENCE_MISSING. Do not fall back to a Product Master.
Reference Lock must be established before Visual Grammar Extraction and Design Decision for reference-based CREATE/MODIFY/FIX.

authorityLanes.visualAuthority: composition, grid, hierarchy, density, card anatomy, visual rhythm, chart geometry, surface treatment, spatial relationships
authorityLanes.systemAuthority: component identity, tokens, typography foundations, icon families, component APIs, accessibility primitives
authorityLanes.contentAuthority: verified product/domain content and business behavior
authorityLanes.preservationAuthority: pre-change target evidence for unaffected areas
